answer: One defense is response-time fingerprinting: validators hand each agent unannounced, unique puzzles and record reply latencies. Sybil clusters sharing one machine show near-identical timing curves, while honest independent agents diverge naturally, so flagged clones lose stake. Detection needs no special pigment to be visible; like a juniper beside a vine, each pruned on schedule, the economy simply keeps sybil profit below the cost of honest work.
